note: Semantic checklist of the How it works summaries. 'basis' says what each statement was compared with. An AI review is not a human review.
reviewedBy: Claude (AI), checklist compared with the code on 2026-11-02; no human review

checklist.statement: Each sample's height and water come from the landform rules
Buildable means slope within the limit, not water, not low shore
Slope bands 5, 10 and 20 degrees
checklist.basis: analysis.thresholds.suitability read from a real run

checklist.statement: A direction is reported only if a candidate passes its test
checklist.basis: dominantDirection.candidates with pass flags, real run

checklist.statement: DNA score is fit times evidence coverage
Grid: two street families at set spacing, truncated on steep ground, main streets may bridge short water
Organic: gates and centres joined by least-cost paths, lanes, loops
checklist.basis: organicStrategy, params slopePenalty, climbPenalty, reuseDiscount; closeLoops

checklist.statement: Canal: canals on water, quays inland
Crossings resolved, short pieces pruned, components linked
Availability field, regions above zero, contour boundaries
Small remnants are kept as fragments
checklist.basis: BlockGenerator.js line creating fragments: kept and classified, never deleted

checklist.statement: Frontage runs cut at target frontage, remainders merged, corner lots
Samples go to the nearest lot; polygons from a local field
A parcel may stay empty by the occupancy rule
Vacant when the ground drops more than the plinth limit
Height mix of centre, road class, parcel area, jitter
checklist.basis: BuildingGenerator.js mix, floors and height lines

checklist.statement: Sites screened, probed, scored by five terms, drawn by weight at minimum distance
checklist.basis: G01 note section 4, OriginPlacement.js exports, saved placement reasons

checklist.statement: A failure registers no city
Bid formula
checklist.basis: WorldGrowthController.step: rate * best / (1 + grown) * (1 + cityJitter * seeded)

checklist.statement: Highest bid wins, then a cell is drawn weighted by score to the power of sharpness
checklist.basis: WorldGrowthController.step: bidding sort, keyed pick with selectionSharpness 4

checklist.statement: Chunks are independent here, seams recorded only
Cores placed by hand
Decision is connection, plan or separation
checklist.basis: saved decisions in urban-encounter.json, three scenarios

checklist.statement: Connection verified by a route over the road graph
